parts.name: K · Phrases, patterns and collocations · tr.117
parts.instructions: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence, using the word given. Do not change the word given. You must use between three and eight words, including the word given.

items.stem:
Some people will do anything to make money. [LENGTHS]
Some people will ____ to make money.
items.explanation_vi: 'Go to any lengths' là làm mọi cách.
items.review_reason: Viết lại câu: có thể có cách đúng khác ngoài đáp án sách.

items.stem:
I don't know why you're saying this is so important. [DEAL]
I don't know why you're ____ this.
items.key: making a big deal out of
accepted: making such a big deal out of
making such a big deal of
items.explanation_vi: 'Make a big deal out of' là làm to chuyện.
items.review_reason: Viết lại câu: có thể có cách đúng khác ngoài đáp án sách.

items.stem:
Simon said he had no idea what he was doing for the first few weeks of his new job. [DEPTH]
Simon said he ____ for the first few weeks of his new job.
accepted: was completely out of his depth
was totally out of his depth
items.explanation_vi: 'Out of your depth' là vượt quá khả năng.
items.review_reason: Viết lại câu: có thể có cách đúng khác ngoài đáp án sách.

items.stem:
